title_zh: 维多利亚时代的飞行马车
title_en: Visions of the Future (10/20): Victorian Dreams of Flying Carriages
note_en: 与其说A，不如说B means "it's less A than B": the speaker rejects one description in favor of a more accurate one. In this text, 这些古老的图画与其说是科学预测，不如说是对天空的告白 means the pictures were "less scientific predictions than declarations of love for the sky." The same 与其…不如… frame also compares actions: 与其像鸟一样不断拍动翅膀，不如用一对固定不动的机翼 "rather than flapping wings like a bird, (better to) use fixed wings."
